tasks.title: Probe adopts the fixed contract and proves safe redirect retries and JSON logs
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order 2, Performance impact, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 5. After contract merges, record/reuse its full main SHA in the shared finding; update pin/lock and both adoption tests together. Keep fetchChecks/postResult/apiError behavior; only compatibility fixes demonstrated necessary by bun run check are in scope for the older 7ce23aa pin jump.

acceptance.expected: Run new local native-fetch regressions first on old pin 7ce23aaf3fa3e038f65ecfed755188b83bde143f and retain intended assertion failures, then on fixed pin: all tests pass, 0 fail. Fake /checks first answers 302 to a second 127.0.0.1:0 server then valid checks: exactly 1 retry, returned checks and 0 destination requests. First answer 200 malformed marker-bearing body then valid: first log includes 'invalid JSON: response body is not valid JSON' and excludes marker; retry succeeds. Follow existing wire-mismatch retry test's injected sleep/schedule and clean up servers. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

acceptance.command: bun install && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, typecheck, full tests and unchanged >=80% line coverage pass. Fix only compatibility failures caused by the contract pin jump; explain any such fix.

Only the contract dependency line changes in package.json, to github:lorenzh/pulse-contract#<full merged main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2>; bun.lock resolves that same SHA. Verify the merge on contract main independently and record/reuse the shared finding from the first consumer so probe, status, notify and console adopt the same SHA. Commit package.json and bun.lock together; other pins stay unchanged.

acceptance.command: bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="%U %S"; for run in 1 2 3; do time bun run test; done'
acceptance.expected: Run on main and candidate, three runs per side on one machine; report each user+system sum and median. Spec expects probe.test_cpu_s delta <+0.1 s. Use bash builtin time, not absent /usr/bin/time.

Run if compatibility work changes more than the pin and tests. First clone pulse-api into <scratch>/pulse-api outside probe and bun install --frozen-lockfile there; it owns bench/run.ts. Use identical concrete api main SHAs on both sides, target probe, --others-ref main and a publicly fetchable candidate ref. Docker with Compose is required; report probe rows against the API-owned budgets.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Whitespace exits 0 and repository-required CI checks pass. PR records full merged contract SHA and shared-finding provenance, check results and the applicable Security impact checklist: fixed secret-safe diagnostics, bounded bodies, redirect protection and full-SHA/lockfile consistency. No new dependency or setting. PR includes old/new adoption outputs and test CPU medians plus conditional fallback evidence; production client/error mapping is not reimplemented.
